build_vision_encoder: build a Gemma4 VisionEncoder module with configurable d_model, num_layers, and patch_size parameters
run_patchify_and_pad: run patchify_and_pad to convert variable-size images into padded patches and positions for batching
extract_soft_tokens: extract non-padding soft tokens from VisionEncoder outputs using the mask to filter real tokens
pad_soft_tokens_to_max: pad variable-length soft tokens to a uniform length for merging into the text sequence
review_VisionEncoder_call: review the VisionEncoder __call__ method to understand the entry, transformer, and exit pipeline
